mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_decision_issue (batch_id, factory_code, issue_key, issue_type, severity, scope_type, scope_key, payload_json, status, revision) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{factoryCode}, #{issueKey}, #{issueType}, #{severity}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{revision})

INSERT IGNORE INTO mrp_decision_issue (batch_id, factory_code, issue_key, issue_type, severity, scope_type, scope_key, payload_json, status, revision) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.factoryCode}, #{item.issueKey}, #{item.issueType}, #{item.severity}, #{item.scopeType}, #{item.scopeKey}, #{item.payloadJson}, #{item.status}, #{item.revision})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_decision_issue SET status=#{status}, resolved_at=#{resolvedAt}, revision=#{revision} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status=#{status}
DELETE FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status='OPEN' AND scope_type='MATERIAL'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status IN ('RESOLVED','DISMISSED') AND scope_type='MATERIAL'
SELECT * FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND issue_key=#{issueKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT * FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY created_at
